title: Simoso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Simoso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Simoso is a light-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (A), Vitality (S).

sections.title: How to Get the Simoso
sections.content:
Location: The Abyss - defeat Simon.

Obtained from The Abyss - defeat Simon.

sections.title: Is the Simoso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (A), Vitality (S). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
